item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a credible 2024 source showing Khamenei ordering specific accident-prevention measures, tighter chain-of-command procedures, hardened custody rules, or a formal nuclear safety overhaul. What exists is mostly indirect: official nonproliferation rhetoric, inspection diplomacy, and conflict-driven brinkmanship.
